title: Two Stars
text: Two Stars. Dont stay in place

product_metadata.title: Link Shades Anti-Slip Sofa Protector | Water Resistant Microsuede Slipcover | Stay-Put Straps | Cover Protects Couches from Dogs & Other Pets (Sofa, up to 72" seat Size, Chocolate)
features: PRESERVE & PROTECT Innovative grip backing and multiple stay-put adjustable straps keep the cover securely in place to safeguard against spills, drips and other messes, dust and hair. Works with fabric, leather and faux leather. A must for homes with pets and kids.

VERSATILE USES Complement any room setting, from a living room to an RV. Compatible with a variety of styles, both armless & with arms: Lazy Boy sofas, RV wall huggers and reclining couches. Several covers together can be used for sectionals.
EASY CARE & DURABLITY Water-repellent soft micro-suede fabric. Toss into the washer and dryer for easy care. Durable and long lasting.

FIND THE PERFECT FIT In addition to the Sofa size (up to 72” seat size), Link Shades furniture protectors come in Recliner size (up to 23"), Loveseat size (up to 50"), XL Sofa (up to 86”). Measure between seat cushions for best fit.
